metadata.description: Project name used as prefix in all resource names.
Primary Azure region for regional resources.
Custom apex domain for the site (e.g., martajazz.com).
Existing Container Registry name (shared across environments).
Resource group of the existing Container Registry.
Container image tag to deploy for the server container app.
GitHub repository URL for the Static Web App source.
GitHub Personal Access Token for SWA deployment.
Bind custom domains to the SWA. Set false on first deploy (DNS zone must exist first); set true on subsequent deploys.
Enable outbound worker metrics. Keep false until release evidence is complete.
Grafana Cloud OTLP metrics endpoint, ending /v1/metrics.
Key Vault URI for the TransitJazzWorkerMetricsPublisherToken secret.
Key Vault URI for the TransitJazzTerraformProvisionerToken secret.
Object ID for the intended workspace-scoped Log Analytics Reader. Leave empty until approved.
DNS zone name (e.g., martajazz.com). Note: this resource intentionally breaks the project naming convention because the zone name IS the domain.

Name of the existing Azure Container Registry.
Principal ID (object ID) of the identity to grant AcrPull.
Name of the Log Analytics workspace.
Name of the Container Apps Environment.
Managed environment name that owns the diagnostic setting.
Existing Log Analytics workspace resource ID.
Object ID of the intended human or agent investigator.
User-assigned Managed Identity resource ID (for ACR pull).
Key Vault-backed Container App secret definitions.
